spreadsheetId.title: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: The Spreadsheet ID to be used as events source

clientId.title: Client Id
clientId.description: Client ID of the sheets application

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Client Secret of the sheets application

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: OAuth 2 access token for google sheets application. This typically expires after an hour so refreshToken is recommended for long term usage.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: OAuth 2 refresh token for google sheets application. Using this, the Google Calendar component can obtain a new accessToken whenever the current one expires - a necessity if the application is long-lived.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: The number of milliseconds before the next poll

repeatCount.title: Repeat Count
repeatCount.description: Specifies a maximum limit of number of fires

splitResults.title: Split Results
splitResults.description: True if value range result should be split into rows or columns to process each of them individually.

range.title: Cells Range
range.description: The range of rows and columns in a sheet to get data from.

majorDimension.title: Major Dimension
majorDimension.description: Specifies the major dimension that the given values should use (ROWS or COLUMNS).

columnNames.title: Column Names
columnNames.description: Optional custom column names that map to cell coordinates based on their position.
